comment: DuckDB-WASM, pinned by SHA-256 of the decompressed bytes. The engine computes every answer, so these are checked before the engine starts, on every visit. scripts/check-pins.mjs compares them against node_modules and two gateways.

extension.comment: Checked by DuckDB's own extension signature inside the engine, which cannot be switched off from a page; the hash here is for the fixture gateway and the pin check only.
